# Three.js r180 (0.180.0)

Vendored from the published `three@0.180.0` npm package on jsDelivr:

- `build/three.module.min.js`
- `build/three.core.min.js`
- `examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js`
- `LICENSE` (MIT; retained alongside the code)

Also included from the same npm version: RoundedBoxGeometry, HDRLoader,
EffectComposer, RenderPass, SSAOPass, OutputPass and their shader/pass/math dependencies.
Additional modules were downloaded through unpkg. Imports are rewritten to local
filenames and `./three.module.min.js`, so no import map or build step is required.

Upstream: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r180
